auditor_maria: Hi - auditor team here. Need evidence bundle for ISO control mapping: history of RBAC changes (role/clusterrolebindings), KMS crypto operation logs tied to service-account rotations, and one complete example timeline for an emergency privilege grant. Deliverables: (A) packaged CSV with our mapping, (B) raw JSON exports, (C) the exact queries/commands you ran, and (D) a 1-page mapping note. Deadline: EOW.

Tess_seceng: Acknowledged. We'll prepare a redacted package. Quick Q: for RBAC events do you prefer k8s auditd or our identity-management audit as primary source?

auditor_maria: Primary should be k8s audit for binding creates/deletes; include identity-management as corroborating evidence.

Sam_infra: Plan: 1) pull kube-apiserver audit logs for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding ops; 2) pull our IDP audit for approval flows; 3) pull Cloud KMS logs (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign) from logging; 4) correlate via request_id/trace_id. Example Splunk filter for k8s audits we will include:

index=k8s_audit event_type IN ("RoleBinding","ClusterRoleBinding") | table _time user verb objectRef requestUID namespace | sort _time

Sam_infra: GCP logging command for crypto ops we will run and include in README:

gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" OR "Decrypt" OR "AsymmetricSign" OR "AsymmetricDecrypt")' --project=redwood-prod --format=json > kms-crypto.json

Noah_sre: We'll redact PII and service-account tokens, but include principalEmail and resourceName fields. We'll also attach a CSV schema mapping. Proposed CSV columns: timestamp, actor_email, action, resource, namespace, request_id, approver, evidence_link, control_mapping.

Tess_seceng: For the emergency grant example, I propose the incident from 2025-09-03 where ops granted tmp-admin to svc-deploy for 2 hours to recover a job. We'll package its timeline: ticket -> approval via Slack + manager -> rolebinding apply -> CI run -> KMS key use for secret unwrap -> verify -> revoke.

auditor_maria: That incident works. Please ensure you include the PR link (redacted), the CI run id, and point to the KMS entry showing keyVersion used. A single crypto log snippet is sufficient.

Sam_infra: Example KMS json snippet we'll include (redacted):

{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"Decrypt","authenticationInfo":{"principalEmail":"svc-rotator@redwood.com"},"resourceName":"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/deploy-key/cryptoKeyVersions/7"},"timestamp":"2025-09-03T08:12:45Z"}

Noah_sre: We'll include a SHA256 checksum for each exported file and encrypt the archive with the auditor public key. archive-bot: upload job will create expiring link.

Tess_seceng: Commands we'll capture in the package (and record the exact query text):
- kubectl --context=prod-eks logs -n kube-system api-server | jq 'select(.objectRef.resource=="rolebindings" or .objectRef.resource=="clusterrolebindings")' > rolebinding-audit.json
- splunk query as above for our SIEM exports
- gcloud logging read ... (crypto ops) -> kms-crypto.json

Tess_seceng: Mapping note draft (will include in bundle): 
- timestamp/_time -> control timeline indicator
- protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail -> actor identity requestor
- objectRef.user/objectRef.subresource -> target resource
- requestUID/insertId -> correlation id across logs

auditor_maria: Also include your short verification notes showing post-change monitoring (what we observed for 24h). A one-paragraph summary is fine.

Sam_infra: Understood. ETA for upload: Friday 18:00 PST. We'll ping when encrypted link is ready.

archive-bot: archiver: preparing export for thread 5412345678 -> /secure-share/compliance/5412345678/ (status: queued)

Tess_seceng: FYI we'll also attach a small script we used to generate the CSV from JSON exports so auditors can reproduce the mapping. We'll include the script as plaintext in README.

auditor_maria: Great, thanks. Please ping here if anything blocks.

Noah_sre: Will do. Closing loop once upload done. :white_check_mark:
